title: play v1
description: One playback of one track, written when it ends (docs/analytics.md). Raw facts only: whether a play 'counts' is decided at recap time from listened_ms and end_reason. The envelope's at_ms is when it ended and track_key is the track's content hash. How the fields are accumulated is pinned by schemas/fixtures/plays.json.

track_id.description: Library track id on the device that played it. Use the envelope's track_key across devices.

started_at_ms.description: Unix ms when audio first started.

listened_ms.description: Track time actually played, excluding pauses and skipped-over spans.

start_pos_ms.description: Position in the track when audio started.

end_pos_ms.description: Position in the track when it ended.

end_reason.description: completed: played to the end (or blended out by a mix). skipped: next. previous: back to the previous track. stopped: playback stopped or the track was removed. replaced: something else was started. error: playback failed. interrupted: the app ended mid-play and the last checkpoint was recovered on the next launch.

context.description: What started it. autoplay: the previous track finished. queue: picked from the up-next list. mix: a DJ Mix deck.

context_ref.description: Crate id when context is crate.

mixed_in.description: Began in a blend from the previous track (Mix into next or DJ Mix).

mixed_out.description: Ended in a blend into the next track.
